summary.text: A centipede nest behind a carved rock door on the Flower Wine Monk inheritance path under Qing Mao Mountain.

claims.text: Behind the rock door a dark long tunnel stretches straight ahead.

The main cave is about three metres high and two metres broad, with many narrow side paths; torchlight only covers about ten steps in the darkness. Deeper on, the main path splits into three branches, and a crystal wall at the end holds swirling spring water behind it.

Under the central pillar of the Rock Forest, crude rock stairs drop to a crude artificial stone door. Characters carved on that door warn that Golden Centipede’s cave is precarious and that Earth Communication is the way to avoid the disaster. In wet soil before the door Fang Yuan digs up an Earth Treasury Flower holding Earth Communication Ear Grass. He leaves without opening the door that visit, reading the carving as a warning of danger past it.

When he opens the door, a dark straight tunnel stretches ahead. A wounded deerling driven inside is swarmed by centipedes until its heartbeat stops. Fang Yuan then hears a buzzing like a chainsaw and identifies the Chainsaw Golden Centipede, a rank three wild Gu and worm king of the centipede cave. He judges that even White Jade Gu defense cannot endure its attack, and that the Flower Wine Monk layout means a seeker to use Earth Communication Ear Grass and avoid the nest rather than force it early.

The main cave is about three metres high and two metres broad, with many narrow side paths. Centipedes gather from walls and ground; Fang Yuan’s concern is the insect king, which he draws out, subdues, and refines. Deeper on, the main path splits into three branches. Using Earth Communication Ear Grass and the refined centipede’s aura to push other centipedes aside, he finds human-dug signs on the left path that he ties to Flower Wine Monk’s earlier work with Thousand Li Earthwolf Spider. After a long descending walk he reaches a crystal wall with swirling spring water behind it and a blue and white flower bud floating there, the Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus.
